Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using a designed inhibitor (TFMI-3_HA) as bait to pull down MASP-3 from human plasma. Acquisition is DDA based on the use of Mascot and the Orbitrap Fusion platform for shotgun proteomics. Quantification is qualitative/semi-quantitative based on unique peptide counts.

scope: TFMI-3_HA was incubated with plasma and captured by anti-HA antibody coated magnetic beads.
Proteins bound to the inhibitor were identified by mass-spectrometry.
The beads were collected, intensively washed, and bound proteins were eluted with two subsequent incubations with 100 ul HA-peptide
Precipitated eluates were subjected to in-solution trypsin digestion folsis performed on an UltiMate 3000 RSLCnano HPLC system (Dionex) coupled to an Orbitrap Fusion mass spectrometer
